description: Portos Secos Alfandegados no RS (2016) is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Porto, Porto Seco, Porto Alfandegado, transportation. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
